projects.name: BS: Cyrodiil Location Database
projects.description: A digital web database for locations included in a Skyrim mod Beyond Skyrim: Cyrodiil.
projects.synopsis:
My first app built in ASP.NET Core and C# through the Mutagen tool created with the purpose of utilizing game data of games produced by Bethesda Software such as the Elder Scrolls and Fallout series. 

Created with the purpose of aiding the progress of level design in the Beyond Skyrim: Cyrodiil project and digitilazing data pulled from multiple sources and compiled in one place. 

One of the biggest obstacles of the project was the inconsistency of location data depending on the source which resulted in confusing results, or missing features. This website tries to minimize if not eliminate this problem by pulling the data from all known sources and pouring it into one single entry.

projects.name: Dailenge
projects.description: A minimalistic mobile daily challenge application with focus on neurodivergent users and productivity.
projects.synopsis:
My first app built in Expo with React Native, TypeScript and GraphQL. Designed with focus on neurodivergent users looking for a fun way to challenge themselves and build productivity. Main feature is picking random challenges to complete during the day. The user can choose to accept upwards of 3 challenges per day. 

The challenges are pulled from a pool of default challenges injected upon signing up, as well as custom challenges created by the user themselves.

projects.name: Delta Kanban
projects.description: Kanban board built in React utilizing DnD-Kit to drag-and-drop todos and columns.
projects.synopsis: My first fullstack project featuring a Kanban board with draggable cards and columns. The backend is powered by MongoDB and the frontend is styled with Tailwind CSS. Project was inspired by a classmate of mine who presented DnD-Kit in his graduation exam and explained it in detail.
